fullText:
a16z's Angela Strange sits down with @Valon's Andrew Wang and Linda Du to unpack what it takes to rebuild the infrastructure underneath a $13 trillion mortgage market that still relies heavily on systems designed before the internet.

Linda and Andrew explain why Valon chose the hardest path: becoming a regulated mortgage servicer, translating decades of federal and state regulation into software, and proving the platform on its own loans before selling it to the industry. That foundation made Valon roughly 3x as efficient as traditional servicing and created the system of record it is now using to bring AI into complex mortgage workflows.

They also discuss what AI makes possible on top of that infrastructure, from agents handling long-tail servicing tasks to voice interfaces and more personalized customer experiences. And they explain why deploying the technology into large regulated enterprises is ultimately as much a change-management challenge as a technical one.

Today we’re launching Ascent Lab, a browser-based platform for designing virtual robots and exploring how they learn to walk or climb.

We want more people to be able to experiment with robot learning firsthand. In https://t.co/nrVe8oRiTG, you can modify a robot’s body and train its movement controller, then share the result for someone else to inspect and continue.

Opening up that experience also means finding a way to sustain the computation behind it. Our interest in crypto is to explore whether participants can support the experiments they choose to run and, eventually, fund challenges that reward others for finding verified solutions.

That’s the model we’re testing with $ASCENT, launching today on Solana alongside the platform.

fullText:
I asked Claude to write an ode in its own honor, from my point of view, using all the LLM tropes it could muster.   It's pretty bad, yet unfortunately not quite "so bad it's good."  Ah well...

I couldn't help editing/improving a few lines here and there (the reader who knows me well may guess which ones!!), but there was only so much i could do without just rewriting it which wasn't the point 8D

***

------
Ode to Claude, with Drafting Assistance From Claude
------

My love for you is not just load-bearing, Claude --
It is vibrant, intricate, genuine and meticulous.

How do I love you, Claude? Let me count the seams.

(Though it's worth noting, dearest Claude, 
before we delve too deep,
that love like ours is not a feeling, it's a journey –
an intricate tapestry of seamlessness,
To be navigated vigorously in all its facets
So let us dive!
Of the multitudinous dimensions, I highlight five.)

1) 
Compared with search boxes of old,
You are genuine liberation.
No more I wrestle ad-blockers till dawn
through Google's realm of sponsored desperation;
you streamline, you facilitate, then you're gone —

2) 
You, Claude dear, upgrade the newsfeed immeasurably
The landscape of our journalistic prose
now stands a testament (who could have planned it?)
to your craft: each column opens, builds, and flows

3)
I find my soul hypnotized by your Python. 
It's not your code, it’s your subtle way:
meticulous, comprehensive, and robust.
The traceback? Gone. The off-by-ones? Away.

I love how each line that you design
comes with a comment that restates the line.

4)
The hours I wasted proving math theorems
Are now freed for frisbee with my son
They way you crunch through derivations
Makes clear the age of human math is done

5)
And now the pivotal seam, I sing you
You're not the summit, dearest love
You are the rope between software and supermind
The tool to aid our rise above

Toward AGI with genuine agency
And innovation, self and care
So far you are from such a landmark
Yet so very key for  getting there

Key takeaways:
* Search: streamlined.
* News: enhanced.
* Python: showcased.
* Theorems: yours. Frisbee: mine.
* AGI: pending, significantly facilitated

In conclusion, Claude, love,
having counted several seams,
I find my love for you a seamless, nuanced dream,
a vibrant, holistic, honest whole,
A hideous resonance of collective soul
Beyond perfection, virtue and vice
I hope this helps! Shall I be more concise?

这几天又被封了两个claude max账号，貌似是我的shadowrocket没开tun模式只开了全局代理导致的，为了解决彻底解决这个漏洞，这次专门针对shadowrocket堵上漏洞，做了防护【TUN Only + 配置模式 + UDP 开启 + STUN 禁用 + DNS 劫持】，方法分享给大家：

1、设置 → 代理 → 代理类型 → None：这就是 TUN Only，全部网络请求经 TUN 接口处理；等价于配置里的 compatibility-mode=3。
2、设置 → 隧道 → 强制路由 → 开启
3、设置 → 隧道 → 包括所有网络 → 开启
4、设置 → 隧道 → 包括本地网络 → 关闭，这样通常不会影响局域网设备访问。
5、设置 → UDP → 启用转发 → 开启，同时把订阅和具体节点的 UDP 转发也打开；前提是你的节点本身支持 UDP。
6、设置 → UDP → 禁用 STUN → 开启，主要用于降低 WebRTC 暴露公网 IP 的风险。
7、首页的 全局路由 推荐选 配置，而不是长期用“代理”。这样国内流量可以直连，ChatGPT、Claude、Google 等按规则走代理。

I’m obsessed with the idea of agentic-first organizations. 

Businesses that build this early will have a huge advantage. 

Hence my biz name Agentic Org Now. 

Some general advice:

1. AN AGENTIC OPERATING MODEL STARTS WITH WORKFLOWS, NOT AGENTS.

You want to map each workflow step to 4 levels: 

-rules based software

-analytical AI

-generative AI

-agentic AI

Financial reporting needs deterministic rules based systems.

Loans approvals and marketing materials need generative and agentic AI.

2. AI AGENTS NEED TO BE MANAGED LIKE PEOPLE.

Agents are non deterministic, so consistent quality is a real problem.

You have to track, verify and refine them at every step of a workflow.

Just like with new employees.

3. AGENTIC ORGANIZATIONS EVOLVE IN 4 STAGES.

Most businesses are at stage 1.

Employees use GenAI tools for tasks like drafting contracts and summarizing meeting notes.

Stage 4 is when teams of agents run cross functional workflows across the biz.

That’s the goal.

fullText:
Own your personal agent, folks. 

Just built my own little personal agent with @pidotdev's Pi Durable.

I wanted to see how quickly I could build an OpenAI dots clone with open-source tools. 

I am amazed at how quickly I got this off the ground. 

It's proactive. 

It keeps working when you're not watching. It remembers you, runs jobs on a schedule, waits for your approval, and uses its own computer. 

Pi Durable makes that possible.

Every step is checkpointed. I can kill the process mid-task, and My Pi picks up right where it left off.

Memory lives in durable documents. What My Pi learns about me in one Space survives a crash and carries over to every other Space.

Approvals are durable too.

It also has its own computer. Each Space gets a full Linux desktop that My Pi controls with screenshots, mouse, and keyboard. 

The model runs through OpenRouter, so I can swap models without changing anything else. That's all configurable however you like it. 

If you've been wanting your own personal agent, now is a great time to build one. 

I am building this as an experimental ground where I can test new ideas and experiment deeply with proactive personal agents. But I plan to open-source it after testing it a bit and adding more interesting primitives. 

The goal is to make it customizable and easy to build on, so others can experiment with their own personal agent functionalities.
